history.headline: Today's faster tempo effort sat at a notably lower HR than a comparable hard run ten days ago.

history.headline: Two easy, low-HR days follow the week's hard tempo — recovery is being taken, and easy-run HR keeps trending down.

history.headline: Back-to-back durability confirmed as the brisk 12 km follows yesterday's long run without HR drift, capping a genuine four-week volume build.
